---
title: "Cohort Overlap & Study Lineage"
---

```{ojs}
catData = FileAttachment("data/catalogue.json").json()
studies = catData.studies
cohortLinks = catData.cohort_membership
```

```{ojs}
htl.html`<div class="hero-header">
  <h1>Cohort Overlap Checker &amp; Preprint Lineage</h1>
  <p>Select candidate studies before running a fixed-effect pGWAS meta-analysis or two-sample Mendelian randomisation to detect shared biobanks/cohorts (e.g. UK Biobank, INTERVAL, deCODE, Fenland, KORA) and superseded preprints.</p>
</div>`
```

::: {.panel-card}
<div class="panel-title">
  <span>1. Select Studies to Check for Participant Overlap</span>
  <span style="font-size:0.78rem;font-weight:400;color:#64748b;">Pre-loaded with major European plasma studies to illustrate biobank overlap</span>
</div>

```{ojs}
activeStudies = studies.filter(s => s.status !== "Superseded Preprint")

viewof selectedStudyIds = Inputs.checkbox(
  activeStudies.map(s => s.study_id),
  {
    value: [
      "sun_2018_29875488",
      "folkersen_2020_33067605",
      "ferkingstad_2021_34857953",
      "pietzner_2021_34648354",
      "sun_2023_37794186",
      "eldjarn_2023_37794188",
      "koprulu_2025_sex_pgwas",
      "patel_2026_somascan7k_pre"
    ],
    format: sid => {
      const s = studies.find(x => x.study_id === sid);
      return `${s.first_author} (${s.year}) [${s.platforms_summary}, N≤${s.max_n.toLocaleString()}]`;
    }
  }
)
```
:::

```{ojs}
// Compute pairwise shared cohorts across selected studies
overlapAnalysis = {
  const selSet = new Set(selectedStudyIds);
  const links = cohortLinks.filter(c => selSet.has(c.study_id));
  const byCohort = new Map();
  for (const l of links) {
    if (!byCohort.has(l.cohort)) byCohort.set(l.cohort, []);
    byCohort.get(l.cohort).push(l);
  }

  const sharedCohorts = [];
  for (const [cohort, arr] of byCohort.entries()) {
    if (arr.length > 1) {
      const minSharedN = Math.min(...arr.map(x => x.n_cohort));
      const maxCohortN = Math.max(...arr.map(x => x.n_cohort));
      sharedCohorts.push({
        cohort,
        n_studies: arr.length,
        studies_involved: arr.map(x => {
          const s = studies.find(st => st.study_id === x.study_id);
          return `${s.first_author} ${s.year} (N=${x.n_cohort.toLocaleString()})`;
        }).join(" ↔ "),
        est_overlap_n: minSharedN,
        max_n: maxCohortN
      });
    }
  }
  sharedCohorts.sort((a, b) => b.est_overlap_n - a.est_overlap_n);
  return { links, sharedCohorts };
}
```

```{ojs}
overlapAnalysis.sharedCohorts.length > 0
  ? htl.html`<div class="overlap-warn">
      <strong>⚠ Participant Overlap Detected Across ${overlapAnalysis.sharedCohorts.length} Biobank / Cohort(s):</strong>
      Do not combine these overlapping studies in standard inverse-variance weighted meta-analysis without accounting for sample correlation (e.g. METAL overlap correction / MTAG / Lin-Sullivan), and check winner's curse / weak-instrument bias in two-sample MR.
      <ul style="margin:0.45rem 0 0 1.2rem;">
        ${overlapAnalysis.sharedCohorts.map(c => htl.html`<li>
          <strong>${c.cohort}</strong> (up to ~${c.est_overlap_n.toLocaleString()} shared individuals): ${c.studies_involved}
        </li>`)}
      </ul>
    </div>`
  : htl.html`<div class="overlap-ok">
      <strong>✓ No Shared Cohorts Detected:</strong> None of the ${selectedStudyIds.length} selected studies share a documented cohort in <code>cohort_membership.tsv</code>.
    </div>`
```

::: {.panel-card}
<div class="panel-title">
  <span>2. Study × Cohort Membership Matrix</span>
  <span style="font-size:0.78rem;font-weight:400;color:#64748b;">Cell colour = cohort sample size N within study · Columns with ≥2 cells indicate overlapping cohorts</span>
</div>

```{ojs}
overlapAnalysis.links.length > 0
  ? Plot.plot({
      height: Math.max(240, selectedStudyIds.length * 32 + 95),
      marginLeft: 185,
      marginBottom: 95,
      style: { background: "transparent", fontSize: "11.5px" },
      x: { label: "Cohort / Biobank", tickRotate: -32 },
      y: {
        label: null,
        domain: selectedStudyIds.map(sid => {
          const s = studies.find(x => x.study_id === sid);
          return `${s.first_author} (${s.year})`;
        })
      },
      color: {
        type: "log",
        scheme: "blues",
        legend: true,
        label: "Cohort sample size N"
      },
      marks: [
        Plot.cell(overlapAnalysis.links, {
          x: "cohort",
          y: d => {
            const s = studies.find(x => x.study_id === d.study_id);
            return `${s.first_author} (${s.year})`;
          },
          fill: "n_cohort",
          inset: 2,
          rx: 4,
          tip: true,
          title: d => {
            const s = studies.find(x => x.study_id === d.study_id);
            return `${s.first_author} (${s.year})\nCohort: ${d.cohort}\nCohort N = ${d.n_cohort.toLocaleString()}\nPlatform: ${s.platforms_summary}`;
          }
        }),
        Plot.text(overlapAnalysis.links, {
          x: "cohort",
          y: d => {
            const s = studies.find(x => x.study_id === d.study_id);
            return `${s.first_author} (${s.year})`;
          },
          text: d => d.n_cohort >= 1000 ? `${(d.n_cohort / 1000).toFixed(1)}k` : String(d.n_cohort),
          fill: d => d.n_cohort > 8000 ? "#ffffff" : "#0f172a",
          fontWeight: "600",
          fontSize: 10.5
        })
      ]
    })
  : htl.html`<p style="color:#64748b;">Select at least one study above to render the cohort membership matrix.</p>`
```
:::

```{ojs}
// Preprint & Lineage tracker table
{
  const lineageStudies = studies.filter(s => s.status !== "Published" || studies.some(x => x.superseded_by === s.study_id));

  return htl.html`<div class="panel-card">
    <div class="panel-title">
      <span>3. Preprint-to-Published Lineage &amp; Active Preprints</span>
      <span style="font-size:0.78rem;font-weight:400;color:#64748b;">Superseded preprints remain archived for reproducibility while pointing to the final peer-reviewed study</span>
    </div>
    <div class="cat-table-wrap">
      <table class="cat-table">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>Study ID</th>
            <th>Author &amp; Year</th>
            <th>Status</th>
            <th>Journal / Server</th>
            <th>Platform &amp; Max N</th>
            <th>Lineage / Superseding Study</th>
            <th>DOI</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          ${lineageStudies.map(s => htl.html`<tr>
            <td class="mono">${s.study_id}</td>
            <td><strong>${s.first_author} (${s.year})</strong></td>
            <td><span class="pg-badge ${s.status === "Superseded Preprint" ? "status-Superseded" : `status-${s.status}`}">${s.status}</span></td>
            <td>${s.journal}</td>
            <td>${s.platforms_summary} (N = ${s.max_n.toLocaleString()})</td>
            <td>
              ${s.superseded_by
                ? htl.html`Replaced by <strong class="mono" style="color:#166534;">${s.superseded_by}</strong>`
                : s.status === "Preprint"
                  ? htl.html`<span style="color:#6b21a8;">Active preprint — monitored by scheduled search Action</span>`
                  : htl.html`<span style="color:#166534;">Peer-reviewed version of earlier preprint</span>`}
            </td>
            <td class="mono"><a href="https://doi.org/${s.doi}" target="_blank">${s.doi}</a></td>
          </tr>`)}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  </div>`;
}
```
